name: dsh-hybrid-connect
description: Hybrid model router for DSH: route each OpenAI request either to Trae remote (via the dsh-trae-connect protocol translation) or to a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Ollama / llama.cpp / LM Studio / vLLM), decided per-request by model-id rules. Reuses dsh-trae-connect's loopback shim as the single DSH-facing entry point.
